messages:
Alex P (PM): Heads-up — we need to prioritize which v1 routes we must keep fully backward-compatible vs. which can be migration-only. Customers asked for clear timelines today.
Maria G (Eng): Agree. Can we align on criteria? my proposal: 1) high-volume routes, 2) routes used in closed-loop SLOs (embeddings/rerank), 3) tool-calling integrations.
Raj S (Platform): Also add ‘routing-critical for dedicated customers’ — Dedicated tenants expect pin-to-version behavior.
Simone L (Research): Quick note: v2 chat/completions unified surface introduces structured output changes; some customers rely on exact logits/metadata shape.
Ben T (Support): From tickets: two large customers (fintech + health) explicitly asked no breaking changes on embeddings shape and function call payload keys for 6 months after GA.
Kim C (CS): +1 — they want migration guides and sample transforms we can run in the console.
Alex P (PM): Proposed decision matrix: keep-as-compatible if (a) top 20% of traffic, (b) enterprise contract clause, or (c) deep integrations (tool-calls). Others => migration path + 90d deprecation window.
Maria G (Eng): Implementation note: we can implement compatibility shim in the gateway: route v1 calls to v2 and 1) remap JSON keys, 2) translate function-calling fields. cheap but adds maintenance cost.
Raj S (Platform): Gateway shim OK for hosted API. For Dedicated/Private, we need an ops-runbook for tenants to opt-in to shim or upgrade. Can't force a shim in their private infra.
Simone L (Research): On embeddings: v2 default uses normalized vectors + new metadata. Back-compat requires offering legacy format flag. That's doable but will increase storage/costs.
Evals Bot: reminder: regression tests will be required for all compatibility shims. Add eval sets: embeddings_dim, function_call_signature, structured_schema.
Ben T (Support): Can we bundle migration guides per-route? small checklist + code snippets (Python/Node) — support will circulate.
Alex P (PM): Launch criteria for v2 default: 1) Gateway shim for top 3 routes, 2) migration guides + console conversion tool, 3) 90d deprecation policy published, 4) core E2E compatibility tests passing.
Kim C (CS): Customers also asked for a canary migration window where both v1 & v2 accepted but with opt-in telemetry. They want rollback hooks.
Maria G (Eng): Canary = feature flag + traffic-split. We should add an automatic fallback to v1 if latency or error spikes > threshold.
Raj S (Platform): We'll need SLA language: if customers pin v1 but we deprecate, provide extended support (paid) for migration. Add to contracts.
Simone L (Research): Edge-case: tool-calling semantics changed: positional vs named args. Migration script should try both and prefer named; log warnings.
Ben T (Support): Example snippet for migration guide would help. e.g.,
```
# v1 function call -> v2 mapping
{"name": "summarize", "args": ["text"]}
# v2 expects
{"name": "summarize", "arguments": {"text": "..."}}
```
Kim C (CS): Can CS org run two playbooks: (1) quick upgrade (console toggle + tests), (2) extended support for complex tool integrations.
Alex P (PM): Timeline proposal: announce deprecation policy at GA, start 90d countdown for non-enterprise routes; enterprise/contracted routes get bespoke timeline. Ship gateway shim + guides in 4 weeks, canary for top customers in 6 weeks.
Maria G (Eng): Risk list: shim drift, test coverage gaps, Dedicated customer opt-in lag.
Raj S (Platform): Mitigations: automated compatibility test harness, a shim health dashboard, and Dedicated upgrade playbook.
Simone L (Research): Also track model-behavior deltas with evals — not just JSON shape. We should surface any quality regressions when mapping v1->v2.
Alex P (PM): Action items:
- Maria: prototype gateway shim + remap rules (2w)
- Raj: Dedicated runbook + opt-in toggle (2w)
- Simone: build eval set for structural + semantic checks (2w)
- Ben/Kim: draft migration guides + example code (1w)
- Evals Bot: add compatibility tests to CI (1w)
Ben T (Support): I'll start a template thread for migration emails to customers.
Kim C (CS): I'll line up the top 5 affected customers for canary invites.
Maria G (Eng): Quick question — do we preserve v1 route names/api paths or use 302-style hints in new docs?
Raj S (Platform): Prefer preserving v1 endpoints in the gateway with an X-Deprecation header and a docs banner. That reduces churn.
Alex P (PM): Agreed. We'll publish explicit mapping and sample CURL commands. Good sync — I'll compile notes and send out the roadmap update.
Ben T (Support): :thumbsup:
Maria G (Eng): leaving this thread open for smaller questions. thanks.
Evals Bot: CI job queued: compat-eval-1775000000
